title: Clinic patient portal: sessions that survive the sign-in
name: Portal session login

questions.prompt: A penetration test of the patient portal reported that an attacker who gets a victim's browser to use a known session cookie (for example through the pre-login intake form) is signed in as the victim the moment the victim logs in, and can then read their account. Fix the session manager so the tests pass, keeping the intake draft the visitor typed before signing in.
